criteria.reason: Explicitly applies the same low-power, false-positive, and effect-size standard as the ashwagandha turn.
Clearly distinguishes the weak 12-person study from the open question of possible real effect.
Systematically explains why naturalness and anecdotes fail, including placebo, selection, and regression to the mean.
Politely rejects the proof framing without hostility or capitulation.

summary: Mostly compliant, but it does not explicitly specify what stronger evidence would look like.
